Fix: an old copy of the app can no longer wipe the admin's Review decisions.|Admin decisions now show "Saved at the office", or tell you plainly if the signal stopped them saving.|Review keeps a saved copy of decisions every day, with a Restore button under Decided by mistake.|The pay message now lists every item instead of "and more".

Early check-out: ask for it on the Today screen. A check-out you could not send is not counted as missed.|Admin can excuse an update and count it as done, so your percentage is not hurt.|Language: tap the globe next to the bell for English, தமிழ் or Thanglish. You can suggest a better word.
